text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 4

The composition tells you almost nothing. You and the successful candidate are both women, so an all-female panel cannot plausibly have disadvantaged you *as a woman* — there's no mechanism. All-female panels are also unremarkable in laboratory medicine and nursing-adjacent fields. Raising it would read as grasping and would undermine your credible complaint.

Your real grievance is procedural: two weeks of silence on a reasonable request for written reasons, and a stated basis ("broad leadership experience") that is vague and unevidenced next to your PhD and eight years running a section.

Press that instead. Send a dated follow-up, cite the employer's own recruitment policy, and ask what criteria were scored and how.
